# Plan 13 as one dependency graph. Run order and ownership: 13_index.md,
# 13_ref_shared_contract.md §6. Every phase is an ordinary tradeoffs-trace run
# (worker + M/A/B reviewers, 3 repair rounds); the scheduler starts a node when
# every node it waits for is DONE.
#
#   13a ─► 13b ─┬─► 13c Pyth ────┐
#               ├─► 13d Stork ───┤
#               ├─► 13e Kaiko ───┼─► 13g blend ─► 13h regime/anchor ─► 13i E2E gate ─► 13j split
#               └─► 13f Redstone ┘
#
# `#+TT_PROGRAM: 4` is what lets the four vendor phases (13c-13f) run at once.
# `#+TT_BRANCHES: stack` gives one branch (and PR) per phase, cut from its
# dependencies:
#   feat/atlas-ips-next--13a        <- feat/atlas-ips-next
#   feat/atlas-ips-next--13b        <- --13a
#   feat/atlas-ips-next--13c/-13d/-13e/-13f   <- each from --13b (four siblings)
#   feat/atlas-ips-next--13g        <- a merge commit of --13c + --13d + --13e + --13f
#   feat/atlas-ips-next--13h/-13i/-13j        <- each from the previous
# The four vendor phases touch disjoint files (one adapter crate + one
# adapters/<vendor>.rs + one vendor fragment each), so their sibling branches
# merge cleanly at the 13g join. Open the PRs stack-style; the join's base is
# the merged vendor set (the program status names each node's branches).
#
# ── ONE manual precondition ──
# Create the integration branch from the merged feat/atlas (2404ded55 already
# contains the plan-12 stack, SourceTick, and the Bugbot health fix):
#   cd /Users/angold.wang/Work/dragon
#   git fetch origin
#   git branch -f feat/atlas-ips-next origin/feat/atlas
#   git push -u origin feat/atlas-ips-next
#
# ── Credentials (needed by 13c-13f live checks and by the 13i gate) ──
# Export these in the shell that starts Emacs/the program. Values are in the
# per-vendor references' §0 (outside the repo); never commit them.
#   PYTH_ACCESS_TOKEN                 (13c)
#   STORK_API_KEY                     (13d)
#   KAIKO_API_KEY, KAIKO_EQUITIES_API_KEY  (13e)
#   REDSTONE_API_KEY                  (13f)
# CI tests use recorded fixtures and need no key; only the recorded live checks do.
#
# ── Before starting ──
#   - no checkout has feat/atlas-ips-next or any --13x branch checked out;
#   - share one cargo target dir across worktrees, set BEFORE C-c m r:
#       (setenv "CARGO_TARGET_DIR" (expand-file-name "~/.cache/dragon-target"))
#   - the runner is installed: readlink ~/.tradeoffs-trace/runner/current.
#
# ── Watch ──
#   C-c m p  program buffer (RET opens a node, k stop, R resume)
#   C-c m d  decision view      C-c m l  runs list
#   bash ~/orgw/work/atlas/indexps/12_watch.sh --watch 20   (auto-finds the newest program)
